label: Week of October 23, 2026
intro: Three options this week: Korean and Japanese rice bowls, an Italian pasta plan with the least effort, and comfort chili with freezer burritos. Each one is a breakfast, two mains that swap between lunch and dinner, and a snack, all made in one prep day.

plans.name: Korean & Japanese Rice Bowls
plans.blurb: Korean BBQ turkey and sous vide teriyaki chicken over one pot of brown rice. Baked oat squares cover breakfast.

recipes.name: Baked Berry Oat Squares + Greek Yogurt
recipes.summary: One pan of oats, eggs, milk and berries baked into squares, with a spoonful of yogurt on top. Reheats in a minute.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. Wrap two squares together; thaw overnight or microwave from frozen for 2 minutes.
steps: Oven to 180°C (350°F). Grease a 9×13 pan (an 8×8 for a half batch).
Stir the oats, eggs, milk, frozen berries and chia in a big bowl with a big pinch of cinnamon. Batch: {{oatbake}}.
Pour into the pan and bake 35–40 minutes, until set in the middle.
Cool and cut into 8 squares (4 for a half batch). Each is about 150 g.
To eat: microwave a square 60–90 seconds and top with the yogurt (keep yogurt in the fridge).
notes: Yogurt cups are fridge-only; the squares freeze.

recipes.name: Korean BBQ Turkey & Veg Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Ground turkey simmered in jarred bulgogi-style sauce over brown rice with stir-fry veg and a side of kimchi.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. Reheats well from frozen; add a splash of water to the rice.
steps: Instant Pot on Sauté: crumble in the turkey and brown about 6 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon. Add the sauce and 80 mL water. Batch: {{turkey}}.
Pressure cook on high for 5 minutes, quick release, then stir.
Rice: cooked in the Instant Pot together with the other main (see the prep tab).
Each container: rice, turkey on top, edamame, and a handful of frozen stir-fry veg straight from the bag.
Keep the kimchi in a separate small tub and add it when you eat.
notes: The veg cooks when you reheat.

recipes.name: Sous Vide Teriyaki Chicken & Edamame Bowls
recipes.summary: Chicken breast cooked gently in the sous vide with teriyaki sauce, over the same brown rice with broccoli.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months in its sauce. Reheat covered so it stays juicy.
steps: Sous vide to 65°C (149°F). Put the chicken and teriyaki sauce in zip bags, press out the air and lower in. Batch: {{chicken}}.
Cook 2 hours. Lift out, slice or shred, and toss with the bag juices.
Each container: rice, chicken and sauce, edamame, and frozen broccoli straight from the bag.
notes: Pick a lower-sodium teriyaki if you can find one.

recipes.name: Clementines & Greek Yogurt with Pepitas
recipes.summary: Yogurt, a clementine on the side and a few crunchy pumpkin seeds.
recipes.freezeTip: Yogurt goes grainy when frozen. Keep in the fridge and eat within 5 days.
steps: Spoon yogurt into small containers.
Keep clementines and seeds separate: peel the fruit when you eat, sprinkle the seeds on top.

steps.text: Instant Pot, all the rice for both mains: {{A-m1.rice+A-m2.rice}} + 1.6× its weight in water. High pressure 22 minutes, natural release 10 minutes.
Oven to 180°C (350°F).
Oat bake: {{A-b.oatbake}}. Stir in a bowl, pour into the pan, bake 35–40 minutes.
Sous vide: set the bath to 65°C. Bag {{A-m2.chicken}} with the teriyaki sauce and lower in for 2 hours.
Rest. Spread the rice on a tray to cool when it is done.
Instant Pot turkey: {{A-m1.turkey}}. Brown, add sauce, high pressure 5 minutes, quick release.
Stir and pour into a bowl to cool.
Lift the chicken out of the bath, slice it, and toss with the juices.
Rest while everything cools.
Cut the oat bake into squares of about 150 g.
At the table with the scale: build each container from the portion card. Frozen veg goes in straight from the bag.
Snack cups for the first {{keepDays}} days.
Label: days 1–{{fridgeDays}} fridge, the rest freezer.

plans.name: Italian, Least Effort
plans.blurb: Rotisserie chicken marinara pasta and a pressure-cooker turkey-lentil bolognese, one pot of pasta for both. Breakfast is no-cook.

recipes.name: Berry Chia Yogurt Parfaits with Oats
recipes.summary: Greek yogurt layered with a stirred berry-oat-chia base. Nothing to cook.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 2 months, though yogurt can turn slightly grainy. Thaw overnight and stir.
steps: In your biggest bowl, stir together {{base}}. Leave 10 minutes, then stir again.
Weigh the base into each jar and spoon the yogurt on top.
Eat cold, or microwave 90 seconds and stir.

recipes.name: Rotisserie Chicken Marinara Pasta
recipes.summary: Whole-wheat pasta with pulled rotisserie chicken, jarred marinara and spinach. Boil, stir, done.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 2 months. Pasta softens slightly; add a splash of water on reheat.
steps: Pull the chicken off the bones with your hands or two forks.
Pasta: cooked together with the other main (see the prep tab). Drain and rinse in cool water.
Drain and rinse {{beans}}.
Each container: pasta, marinara, chicken, beans and a lump of frozen spinach straight from the bag.
Sprinkle the parmesan on when you eat.
notes: Rotisserie chicken is about 450 g of meat per bird.

recipes.name: Turkey & Lentil Bolognese Pasta
recipes.summary: Ground turkey and lentils in marinara, pressure cooked, over the same whole-wheat pasta.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. The sauce reheats like new.
steps: Instant Pot on Sauté: brown the turkey about 6 minutes.
Add the rinsed lentils, frozen peppers, marinara and 250 mL water. Don't stir. Batch: {{bolognese}}.
High pressure 12 minutes, natural release 10 minutes, then stir.
Each container: pasta, bolognese on top, and frozen broccoli straight from the bag.
Sprinkle the parmesan on when you eat.
notes: Lentils go in dry, so they need the water.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese & Clementines
recipes.summary: Cottage cheese with a clementine and a few pumpkin seeds. Nothing to make.
recipes.freezeTip: Cottage cheese turns watery when frozen. Keep in the fridge and eat within 5 days.
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into small containers.
Keep fruit and seeds separate and add them when you eat.

steps.text: Big pot of water on to boil. Pasta for both mains: {{B-m1.pasta+B-m2.pasta}}. Boil about 10 minutes.
Parfait base: {{B-b.base}}. Stir in a bowl and leave to thicken.
Instant Pot: sauté the turkey, then the lentils, peppers, marinara and water for {{B-m2.bolognese}}. High pressure 12 minutes.
Rest. Drain and cool the pasta on a tray.
Drain the pasta and rinse it in cool water.
Pull the rotisserie chicken apart.
At the table with the scale: build each container from the portion card. Frozen spinach and broccoli go in straight from the bag.
Snack cups for the first {{keepDays}} days.
Label: days 1–{{fridgeDays}} fridge, the rest freezer.

plans.name: Comfort Chili & Burritos
plans.blurb: A beef and bean chili and a cheddar chicken quinoa bake, one batch of quinoa for both. Freezer breakfast burritos.

recipes.name: Egg & Cheddar Breakfast Burritos
recipes.summary: Scrambled egg, black beans, peppers and cheddar rolled in a whole-wheat tortilla. Freeze, then reheat in the microwave.
recipes.freezeTip: Wrap each burrito in foil or paper. Freezes for up to 3 months; microwave from frozen 2–3 minutes, turning once.
steps: Whisk the eggs and egg whites. Cook in the air fryer or a nonstick pan with the frozen peppers, drained black beans and cheddar. Batch: {{filling}}.
Spoon the filling onto the tortillas and roll up tightly.
Wrap each burrito and refrigerate or freeze.
To eat: microwave 90 seconds, or 2–3 minutes from frozen.

recipes.name: Instant Pot Beef & Bean Chili with Quinoa
recipes.summary: Lean beef, kidney beans, tomatoes and salsa in one pot, spooned over quinoa.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 3 months. Chili reheats like new.
steps: Instant Pot on Sauté: brown the beef about 6 minutes.
Add the rinsed beans, tomatoes (with juice), salsa and frozen peppers. Don't stir. Batch: {{chili}}.
High pressure 12 minutes, natural release 10 minutes, then stir.
Quinoa: cooked in the Instant Pot or rice cooker together with the other main (see the prep tab).
Each container: quinoa, chili on top, and frozen corn straight from the bag. Sprinkle cheddar on when you eat.
notes: Add chili powder or hot sauce at the table.

recipes.name: Chicken, Broccoli & Cheddar Quinoa Bake
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs, quinoa, broccoli and cheddar in one baking dish. Mix, bake, portion.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 2 months. Add a splash of water on reheat.
steps: Oven to 200°C (400°F). Spread the chicken thighs on a lined tray with a little oil, salt and pepper. Batch: {{chicken}}.
Bake 25–30 minutes until 74°C (165°F) inside. Rest, then slice with kitchen scissors.
Drain and rinse {{beans}}.
Each container: quinoa, sliced chicken, beans, cheddar on top and frozen broccoli straight from the bag.
notes: Reheating melts the cheddar into the quinoa.

recipes.name: Berry Chia Pudding Cups
recipes.summary: Greek yogurt, milk and chia set overnight with berries.
recipes.freezeTip: Freezes for up to 2 months; thaw in the fridge and stir.
steps: Stir {{pudding}} together and leave 10 minutes, then stir again.
Spoon into small jars over the frozen berries.
Fridge overnight. Eat cold.

steps.text: Instant Pot, all the quinoa for both mains: {{C-m1.quinoa+C-m2.quinoa}} + 1.25× its weight in water. High pressure 1 minute, natural release 10 minutes.
Oven to 200°C (400°F).
Chicken thighs on a lined tray for {{C-m2.chicken}}. Season and slide into the oven.
Instant Pot chili: {{C-m1.chili}}. Brown the beef, add the rest, high pressure 12 minutes.
Rest. Spread the quinoa on a tray to cool.
Slice the chicken with kitchen scissors.
Burrito filling: {{C-b.filling}}. Cook in the air fryer or a nonstick pan, then stir in the beans and cheddar.
Chia pudding base: {{C-s.pudding}}. Stir and leave to set.
Rest while everything cools.
Roll the burritos and wrap each one.
At the table with the scale: build each container from the portion card. Frozen broccoli and corn go in straight from the bag.
Fill the snack jars over the berries.
Label: days 1–{{fridgeDays}} fridge, the rest freezer.
